user_query: I want to suggest a reliable language translation tool for my friend studying abroad, which translates phrases and sentences from English to the local language and supports language detection.

TaskList.description: Research and identify language translation tools that facilitate translations from English to various local languages and support language detection.
Compare the features of identified translation tools to determine which ones offer phrase and sentence translation as well as language detection functionality.
Select the top recommended translation tool based on feature comparison and reliability.
Provide a summary of the recommended translation tool along with its key features for the user.
